channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Yoshinobu Yamamoto must remain the calm in the Dodgers' storm
item.description: Yoshinobu Yamamoto says nothing has changed since his iconic World Series play, but he has become an essential leader as the Dodgers chase a three-peat.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard and LeBron James shine at All-Star Game in L.A., but young legs prevail
item.description: LeBron James focused on bonding with teammates from around the league and figuring out a new All-Star Game format, passing on talk about his future.

item.title: A California county’s only hospital cleared a federal hurdle, but it still needs millions to reopen
item.description: A new federal law will restore the “critical access” designation for Glenn Medical Center, the only hospital in Glenn County. As a result, once it reopens, the hospital qualifies for full Medicare reimbursement, a key source of revenue.

item.title: Strong storm set to pummel L.A. with heavy rains, flooding and beach hazards
item.description: A strong storm system is set to hit Southern California starting Sunday, bringing potential thunderstorms, damaging winds and dangerous surf.

item.title: Bass helped Raman win reelection. Now Raman wants to unseat her. Some call it 'a betrayal'
item.description: Raman’s last-minute run for mayor has shocked the city’s political elite and infuriated Bass' supporters. Some observers called it a betrayal of Shakespearean proportions.

item.title: Michael Silverblatt, 'genius' host of KCRW literary show 'Bookworm,' dies at 73
item.description: Silverblatt’s 30-minute show, which ran from 1989 to 2022, included interviews with celebrated authors including Gore Vidal, Kazuo Ishiguro, David Foster Wallace, Susan Orlean, Joan Didion and Zadie Smith.

item.title: The two separate lives of Gavin Newsom detailed in new memoir
item.description: In his new memoir "Young Man in a Hurry," Gov. Gavin Newsom writes about the occasional interludes into his father's life charmed by the Getty oil family's affluence and the everyday struggle living with his single mom.

item.title: Sprawling network of brothels in Ventura and L.A. counties is busted, authorities say
item.description: A massive Southern California brothel ring was busted by authorities, leading to two arrests, officials said.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie kidnapping investigation draws scrutiny as case drags on
item.description: Criticism of the local sheriff's department's handling of the case has mounted, with questions raised about its ability to handle such a high-profile, complex crime under the harsh media spotlight.

item.title: DNA recovered from glove found near Guthrie home that appears to match glove worn by suspect
item.description: The glove worn by the person in the door video appears consistent with a glove recovered about 2 miles from Guthrie’s home.
